Review of [Lulu and Georgia](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/www.luluandgeorgia.com)

* * *

## [OK product, although a previous return. Don't appreciate daily spam emails after my purchase](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6a5786d87b77215a366d2c17)
Nice chair, I did not appreciate the box and packing we received. It was clearly a previous returned product they did not care to repack. There were a few blemishes but not visible so I just kept it. Still holding final judgment to make sure nothing else shows up as to why this was returned prior. Also, I hate getting daily ads now from Lulu and Georgia. I did not sign up for this and I don't like being added to a mailing list because I made one purchase and definitely did NOT request to be on a daily email distribution list. My guess is I am getting other SPAM emails because they are sharing my contact info. Very annoying you think I want more emails and send without my consent (you'll probably tell me there was a tiny little box I didn't check-off to opt out)- rather, you should automate an 'opt-out' and force a check to opt in.

July 10, 2026

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Jul 16, 2026

Hi Mike,

We sincerely apologize for the condition of the packaging and the blemishes on your chair. We understand your frustration regarding the unsolicited emails and your concern about your contact information. You can easily opt out at any time by clicking the "Unsubscribe" link at the bottom of any of our emails.
